contract.diagnosis: Sequential source-equivalent GS hits cap and matches native failures. Combined rows solve per-step residuals; a separate large-step primal drift remains. Smaller converged substeps reduce position error.
contract.implementation: Python scipy sparse direct solve of diagonally equilibrated J W J^T+alpha. Same residual Armijo rule as cord; update x and lambda together.
contract.exact_equation: Position primal residual rx=x-x_pred-W J^T lambda is measured, not hidden. Adding rx to an approximate Newton update without geometric stiffness failed tested large steps and is not recommended as a fix.
contract.scope: Offline controls only. No native integration, arbitrary mesh solve or exact force-equilibrium claim.

settings.row_order: Unique free-involving grid edge strains, every face normalized shear in face order, every interior hinge in sorted-edge order.
settings.hard_row_constraint: |edge|/rest-1; identical to the duplicated face yarn equations on THIS aligned grid.

expected.equilibrium_limit: Combined+substeps meets the discrete position control but retains measured finite-step force bias; do not claim an exact nonlinear static solve.

cases.scope: Rectangular-grid experiment. Generic triangles may have additional hard-row dependencies; this is not a general cloth global-solver implementation.
